_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: without directory exclusion, C# test infra files count as production
expectedRed.why: On correct code isSpecFile() returns true for files under Lib/Testing/ (excluded by directory), so the assertion that it returns false fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the directory check was removed.
